metaDescription: Try Libyan Freelance free for 30 days — no card required. Starter, Pro, and Premium plans for proposal quotas.
title: Freelancer plans
subtitle: 30 days free — no card needed. Then choose the plan that matches your proposal volume.
trialNote: No card required at signup. The free trial lets you submit proposals within the trial allowance.
featurePlatformPay: Platform payments for subscriptions & points only
disclaimerBody: Libyan Freelance is an advertising platform and technical intermediary connecting clients with freelancers. The platform does not receive project payment amounts, does not hold parties' funds, and does not guarantee project delivery or payment. Agreement and payment are made directly between the client and the freelancer.
platformPaymentsNote: Electronic payments inside Libyan Freelance are only for subscriptions, points purchases, and digital services offered by the platform.
checkoutBlocked: Activation is on hold until a real payment gateway is available.
